seeds.sg-6-2-0-0: Within the echoing obsidian antechamber, cold ceramic tiles hum against your boots as you weigh the final sacrifice of the seed.
seeds.sg-6-2-0-1: Beside the grinding basalt gears of the inner vault, a forgotten ledger lies open, detailing the bitter cost of past harvests.
seeds.sg-6-2-1-0: Beneath a chandelier of fractured prisms, rusted iron levers groan under your grip while the heavy air tastes of ozone and dry salt.
seeds.sg-6-2-1-1: Slipping past the sentry's blind spot with your darkened lantern, you discover an unsealed maintenance hatch bypassing the grinding bronze seals.
seeds.sg-6-2-1-2: In the alcove of weeping crystals, a saline condensation drips onto your bare shoulders as you inspect the cracked pneumatic seals.
seeds.sg-6-2-1-3: Across a chasm of singing glass plates, a spectral reflection mimics your every hesitation while the abyss hums a low, warning note.
seeds.sg-6-2-1-4: Beside a mural of fused silica depicting the ancient drought, you pry open a maintenance box to expose the sputtering control circuits.
seeds.sg-6-2-1-5: Within the narrow ventilation flue choked with white salt dust, your cramped fingers search for the hidden latch that releases the pressure valve.
seeds.sg-6-2-2-0: In the vaulted gallery of hollow resonators, your heavy footsteps trigger a cascade of melodic echoes that threaten to wake the lower guardians.
seeds.sg-6-2-2-1: Under the flickering amber glow of emergency beacons, a corroded brass valve resists your straining muscles as boiling steam hisses overhead.
seeds.sg-6-2-2-2: Because no debt binds your name to the basin, a wary archivist hands you the master schematic of the lower seed vaults without demanding a toll.
seeds.sg-6-2-2-3: Within the subterranean cistern of bitter brine, floating fragments of old maps swirl around your shins as you search for the emergency drainage plug.
seeds.sg-6-2-2-4: Before the towering vault doors etched with the history of the lensfolk, your cold ceramic key fits into the intricate frost-patterned keyway.
seeds.sg-6-2-2-5: In the chamber of whispering lenses, hundreds of curved mirrors catch your lantern light and scatter blinding beams across the damp stone floor.
seeds.sg-6-2-2-6: Beside a collapsed scaffolding of copper pipes, you salvage a length of rigid tubing to wedge against the jammed secondary locking mechanism.
seeds.sg-6-2-2-7: Within the alcove dedicated to the forgotten rain-seers, a dry basin waits for an offering that you must decide whether to give or withhold.
seeds.sg-6-2-2-8: Across the trembling glass bridge spanning the deep subterranean shaft, a rising gale from the impending monsoon whistles through the iron struts.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-1: Inside the central control panopticon, banks of dead indicator lights gaze down upon you like the blind eyes of ancient stone deities.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-2: Within the vault's deep refrigeration tier, frost clings to your eyelashes while you calculate the exact temperature needed to preserve the harvest.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-3: Beside a heap of shattered quartz lenses, an old automated chime tolls a single mournful note every time the tectonic plates shift below.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-4: In the sunken gallery where the air tastes of sulfur and old dust, your trembling hand traces the groove of an uncast bronze seal.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-5: Under the massive vaulted ceiling of fused green glass, a network of copper veins pulses faintly with the residual thermal energy of the desert.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-6: Before the sealed titanium bulkhead of the primary seed repository, a row of manual override cranks waits for someone strong enough to turn them.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-7: Within the shadow of the great condensing tower, droplets of pure water gather on your coat as the subterranean humidity climbs rapidly.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-8: Across the floor of polished obsidian, a trail of dried white salt crystals marks the path taken by the previous generation's doomed runner.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-9: Beside the humming dynamo of the lift shaft, a discarded oil lamp flickers out, plunging you into absolute darkness save for your own coals.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-10: In the alcove of the weeping statues, water slowly trickles from carved stone eyes into a basin that has remained dry for a hundred years.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-11: Within the narrow service tunnel lined with acoustic tiles, every breath sounds like a thunderclap against the silence of the dead city.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-12: Before the secondary biometric scanner, your bare palm presses against the cold metal plate while the system checks your lineage for authority.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-13: Across the threshold of the innermost sanctum, the floor drops away into a sheer pit crossed only by a narrow rail of wrought iron.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-14: Because the jagged glass-burn scar across your forearm matches the old protocol, the automated defense turret retracts into the ribbed ceiling.
seeds.sg-6-2-3-15: Within the chamber of the great balance, two heavy iron pans hang suspended in stillness, waiting for you to place the seed upon them.
seeds.sg-6-2-4-0: Under the low-hanging basalt lintel of the sub-vault, your shoulders ache as you heave against the rusted winch of the floodgate.
seeds.sg-6-2-4-1: In the twilight glare of phosphor-lamps, the core of the seed vault hums with a restrained, terrifying potential energy.
seeds.sg-6-2-4-2: Beside the deep sump where the basin's drainage channels converge, a sudden rush of cold air announces the arrival of the monsoon underground.
seeds.sg-6-2-4-3: Within the vault's innermost reliquary, the air is so dry and still that your skin feels tight and stretched like parchment.
seeds.sg-6-2-4-4: Before the grand obsidian console, three separate slots wait for decisions that will shape the survival or doom of every western lamp-town.
seeds.sg-6-2-4-5: Across the glistening salt-encrusted floor of the central hall, your footprints leave a dark, damp trail that stands out starkly against the white crust.
seeds.sg-6-2-4-6: Within the hollow pillar of singing glass, your name is whispered back to you by unseen acoustic chambers buried deep in the bedrock.
seeds.sg-6-2-4-7: Beside the final heavy titanium door of the seed repository, the cold ceramic key grows warm in your fist as if anticipating the latch.
seeds.sg-6-2-5-0: At the apex of the central vault platform, the great seed-urn opens its iron petals to reveal the pale, dormant grains of the old world.
seeds.sg-6-2-5-1: Before the yawning breach of the water-conduit, you must choose whether to flood the basin now and save the crops or preserve the dry vault.
seeds.sg-6-2-5-2: Overlooking the vast submerged expanse of the saltglass sea from the high observatory balcony, you hold the destiny of Candlemere in your palm.
seeds.sg-6-2-5-3: In the quiet stillness after the vault mechanism locks into place, you face the long walk back into a world transformed by water and salt.
seeds.sg-d-6-2: Rushing blindly past the warning chimes, you force the main lock without setting the pressure release, sealing yourself forever inside the collapsing vault.
